title: Create landing page with direct join/authentication access

requirements.summary: Create a dedicated landing page at '/' that serves as the public entry point with a 'Join RevReel' button triggering Internet Identity login, redirecting authenticated users to '/feed'
acceptanceCriteria: A landing page is rendered at the root route '/' for unauthenticated users
The page displays a prominent 'Join RevReel' button that initiates Internet Identity login
After successful login, the user is automatically redirected to '/feed'
Authenticated users visiting '/' are immediately redirected to '/feed'
The landing page is fully accessible without authentication (no AuthGuard wrapping it)
The landing page visually reflects the RevReel brand (dark theme, neon accents, car culture aesthetic consistent with the rest of the app)

file_operations.description: Create a new LandingPage component that displays the RevReel branding with a hero section featuring the generated landing hero background image (frontend/public/assets/generated/landing-hero.dim_1920x1080.png). Include a prominent 'Join RevReel' button that calls the login() function from useInternetIdentity. Use useEffect to check if the user is authenticated via useInternetIdentity and redirect to '/feed' using TanStack Router's useNavigate if identity exists. Style using dark theme with neon accents, Barlow font, and glassmorphism effects consistent with index.css tokens. The component must NOT be wrapped in AuthGuard and should be publicly accessible.

requirements.summary: Update the TanStack Router configuration to register the landing page at '/' and ensure all authenticated app routes remain accessible with the Layout shell applied only to authenticated routes
acceptanceCriteria: The root route '/' renders the new LandingPage component without the Layout shell
All existing app routes (feed, profile, upload, discover, meets, mechanics, inbox, admin, notifications, builds, classifieds) remain accessible and functional
Navigation between landing page and app routes works correctly

file_operations.description: Add a new root route '/' that renders the LandingPage component without the Layout shell or AuthGuard. Import the LandingPage component. Ensure the existing authenticated routes (feed, profile, upload, discover, meets, mechanics, inbox, admin, notifications, builds, classifieds) continue to use the Layout shell and remain at their current paths. The landing page route should be a sibling to the Layout-wrapped routes, not nested under Layout.

requirements.summary: Design the landing page with a visually striking hero section including RevReel branding, tagline, and the 'Join RevReel' button using the dark theme with neon effects and car culture aesthetic
acceptanceCriteria: Landing page displays the RevReel brand name/logo prominently
A tagline or brief description of the platform is shown
The 'Join RevReel' button is visually prominent and clearly actionable
Page uses the dark theme, neon effects, and Barlow font consistent with the rest of the app
Page is responsive and looks good on mobile and desktop

file_operations.description: Design the hero section within LandingPage to display the RevReel logo from frontend/public/assets/generated/revreel-logo.dim_256x256.png and a bold tagline (e.g., 'The Ultimate Car Culture Video Platform'). Use the generated landing hero background image (frontend/public/assets/generated/landing-hero.dim_1920x1080.png) as a background with cinematic motion blur effect. Style the 'Join RevReel' button with neon accent colors from index.css (--primary, --accent), glassmorphism effects, and hover animations. Ensure responsive layout using Tailwind utilities that work on both mobile and desktop. Use Barlow font family and maintain consistency with the dark theme OKLCH color tokens defined in index.css.
